# Bundled dependencies

Local copies allow the site to run without CDN requests after cloning.

- D3 7.9.0: https://github.com/d3/d3 (ISC; see D3-LICENSE).
- topojson-client 3.1.0: https://github.com/topojson/topojson-client (ISC; see TOPOJSON-LICENSE).
- world-atlas 2.0.2, countries-110m.json: https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas (ISC package; see WORLD-ATLAS-LICENSE). Map derived from Natural Earth public-domain cartography.

Downloaded from jsDelivr, pinned to the versions above. Font files and their OFL licence remain in the P2 EB_Garamond directory.
